Audit general 2D/3D trajectories with QC decisions and source-row lineage

Source: R/qc2-general.R
aqt_qc2_report.Rd

Data frames, CSV files and validated aqt_tracks are accepted. Source column names may be mapped explicitly; milliseconds can be converted to seconds. Physical mm, cm and m are converted by an explicit scale to the requested analysis units, without claiming a physical calibration. Source rows are retained and each accepted or rejected step links its two original rows. The output contains no interpolated or identity-corrected measurements.

Usage

aqt_qc2_report(
  data,
  gap_limits_s,
  speed_limits = Inf,
  step_limits = Inf,
  column_map = NULL,
  units = NULL,
  target_units = NULL,
  coordinate_system = NULL,
  time_scale = 1,
  session_id = "study",
  camera_id = "sensor"
)

Arguments

data

Data frame, CSV path, or validated aqt_tracks object.

gap_limits_s

Positive finite movement-gap policies in seconds.

speed_limits

Positive speed thresholds in analysis units/s; Inf disables.

step_limits

Positive displacement thresholds in analysis units; Inf disables.

column_map

Optional named character vector: canonical field names (track_id,time_s,x,y, plus optional session_id,camera_id,z,observed, frame_id,source_row) mapped to source column names.

units

Declared source coordinates: px, mm, cm or m. Inherited from aqt_tracks if omitted.

target_units

Analysis units: px, cm or m; defaults to source units, except mm converts to cm. Inherited aqt_tracks cannot be rescaled here.

coordinate_system

image or tank; inherited from aqt_tracks if omitted.

time_scale

Number of seconds per source time unit (e.g. .001 for ms).

session_id, camera_id

Scope labels when absent from source data.

Value

List containing canonical tracks, policy summaries, exclusion counts, full original source table, a source-to-step lineage ledger and hashes.
